description: Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen - Aerolíneas comerciales y carga que operan en el aeropuerto 2020 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Todas las aerolíneas comerciales y de carga que operaron durante el 2020 en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Its tags are aerolineas Tocumen 2020, aerolineas carga 2020, aerolineas comerciales 2020, aviación. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2021-02-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
